title: MMO Addiction-Engagement Longitudinal Project CZ
descriptions: Longitudinal data on Czech MMO Gamers with focus on gaming addiction and engagement and related psychological and behavioural factors. Three waves of data collection (after 6 months each) collected in 2013 and 2014, N=9460. Data collection and management supported by Czech Science Foundation, projects P407/12/1831 and GA15-19221S
